svg.aria-label: How Anzu works: in the Anzu window a cursor ticks two books, Moby-Dick and Pride and Prejudice, presses Unlock and convert 2 books, answers Close Kindle and continue in a dialog that says the Kindle app is open, and then each book fills its three-colour track from with DRM to EPUB. A list on the left lights each step as it happens.
svg.text: Anzu asks first, then each book fills its track.
